title: Important Update: Compliance and Eligibility Requirements of Binance Referral Program
text: Products and services referred to in this announcement may not be available in your location. Fellow Binancians, To comply with applicable regulatory obligations and to maintain the security and integrity of our platform, users participating in the  Binance Referral Pro  and  Affiliate Program  must continue to satisfy all relevant eligibility and compliance requirements on an ongoing basis. Access to the Referral Pro and Affiliate Program, including any associated commission distributions, may be restricted or suspended where a user does not meet these requirements, including: 1. Incomplete KYC Verification or KYC Documentation The  Know Your Customer (KYC) verification  process remains incomplete or required KYC documentation has not been fully submitted or approved. Users must complete the KYC process to maintain eligibility. 2. Referral Program Restricted in Certain Regions The Referral Pro and Affiliate Program are unavailable in certain locations due to regulatory, legal or other restrictions. Users residing in such locations will be ineligible to participate.  3. Violation of Terms of Use The user’s account has been found to be in violation of Binance’s  Terms of Use  or other applicable policies. 4. Latest Terms and Conditions Not Accepted The user has not reviewed and accepted the latest applicable Terms and Conditions. Users are required to review and accept the most recent Terms and Conditions via our website to remain eligible for participation. Users who continue to meet all eligibility requirements are not affected.  If you have received a separate notification regarding your account, please follow the instructions provided to avoid any interruption to your participation or commission distributions. For further questions, please contact  Customer Service . Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-06-03
